units.source_text: 不用说，澡塘里的人正议论着她们。

en.t: Needless to say, the people in the bathhouse were talking about them.

units.source_text: 两人的头发又长又粗，格外丰盛。

en.t: The two girls had hair that was long, thick, and exceptionally luxuriant.

units.source_text: 那些濡湿的乌亮黑发，不由得使其他姐妹感到她们俩身上有一股天生的诱人魅力。

en.t: That wet, glossy black hair naturally made the other sisters feel that the two of them possessed an inborn alluring charm.

units.source_text: 况且两人整个夏天都是同床共被。

en.t: Besides, the two of them had shared the same bed and bedding all summer long.

units.source_text: 今宵还会拿到八月份的分配呢。

en.t: Tonight they would also receive their share for August.
